#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# ── Dimensions (A1 portrait @ 150 DPI) ───────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Color Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT    = (17, 22, 40)
BG_PANEL   = (22, 28, 50)
GRID       = (30, 38, 62)
ACCENT     = (0, 212, 255)      # electric cyan
ACCENT_DIM = (0, 150, 200)
ACCENT2    = (20, 184, 166)     # teal
ACCENT2_DIM= (15, 140, 125)
WARN       = (251, 191, 36)     # amber
WARN_DIM   = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG    = (45, 35, 10)
RED        = (239, 68, 68)
TEXT       = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM   = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT = (80, 88, 105)
WHITE      = (245, 248, 255)
DOT_COLOR  = (17, 22, 40)

# Margins
ML = 160
MR = 160
MT = 150
MB = 120
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML
CX = W // 2  # center x

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
SANS_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
SANS_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
MONO_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
MONO_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DJ_B    = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
DJ_MONO = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DJ_MONOB= f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"

def load(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# ── Create Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Background dot grid
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT_COLOR)

# ── Drawing Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def text(xy, txt, font, fill=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def tbbox(txt, font):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)

def tw(txt, font):
    bb = tbbox(txt, font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt, font):
    bb = tbbox(txt, font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctext(x, y, txt, font, fill=TEXT):
    """Center text at (x,y)."""
    bb = tbbox(txt, font)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill, width=width)

def wrap_text(txt, font, max_w):
    words = txt.split()
    lines = []
    cur = ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font) > max_w:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_wrapped(x, y, txt, font, fill, max_w, line_h):
    """Draw wrapped text, return bottom y."""
    for line in wrap_text(txt, font, max_w):
        text((x, y), line, font, fill)
        y += line_h
    return y

def section_accent(x, y, color):
    """Draw a small accent mark for section headers."""
    rect(x, y, x + 6, y + 52, color, radius=3)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = MT + 50

section_accent(ML, Y, ACCENT)
text((ML + 30, Y - 2), "JS Framework Benchmark", load(SANS_B, 130), WHITE)
text((ML + 30, Y + 135), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", load(SANS_B, 50), ACCENT2)
text((ML + 30, Y + 195), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
     load(SANS_R, 32), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 280

# ── Hero stat cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CARD_W = (INNER_W - 90) // 3
CARD_H = 270
HERO_Y = Y

hero_cards = [
    {"num": "60+",         "label": "Official Benchmark Runs",    "sub": "Published since 2017",         "color": ACCENT},
    {"num": "55 \u2192 146", "label": "Chrome Versions Covered", "sub": "Spanning ~8 years of releases", "color": ACCENT2},
    {"num": "Chrome 118",   "label": "Major Methodology Shift",   "sub": "Scoring method changed",        "color": WARN},
]

for i, card in enumerate(hero_cards):
    cx = ML + i * (CARD_W + 45)
    rect(cx, HERO_Y, cx + CARD_W, HERO_Y + CARD_H, BG_ALT, radius=22)
    d.rounded_rectangle((cx, HERO_Y, cx + CARD_W, HERO_Y + CARD_H), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

    # Top accent
    rect(cx + 30, HERO_Y + 24, cx + 110, HERO_Y + 30, card["color"], radius=3)

    # Number
    nfont = load(DJ_MONOB, 100) if i < 2 else load(DJ_MONOB, 52)
    text((cx + 35, HERO_Y + 65), card["num"], nfont, card["color"])
    # Label
    text((cx + 35, HERO_Y + 175), card["label"], load(SANS_B, 34), WHITE)
    # Sub
    text((cx + 35, HERO_Y + 220), card["sub"], load(SANS_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

Y = HERO_Y + CARD_H + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TIMELINE — CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
section_accent(ML, Y, ACCENT)
text((ML + 30, Y - 2), "Benchmark Timeline", load(SANS_B, 64), WHITE)
text((ML + 30, Y + 68), "Official runs across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026",
     load(SANS_R, 32), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 130

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1150
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

# Timeline data
years_data = [
    ("2017\u20132019", "55, 58, 62, 69",   4,  "Early era", False),
    ("2020",          "83 \u2013 87",        5,  "GitHub Pages", False),
    ("2021",          "88 \u2013 96",        9,  "Monthly cadence", False),
    ("2022",          "97 \u2013 108",      13,  "2 Windows runs", False),
    ("2023",          "109 \u2013 120",     12,  "Methodology overhaul", True),
    ("2024",          "121 \u2013 131",     12,  "1 Windows run", False),
    ("2025",          "132 \u2013 143",     12,  "Keyed-only alternating", False),
    ("2026",          "144 \u2013 146",      3,  "Latest: macOS", False),
]

n = len(years_data)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 85
TRACK_LEFT = ML + 100
TRACK_RIGHT = RIGHT - 60
TRACK_W = TRACK_RIGHT - TRACK_LEFT
SPACING = TRACK_W / (n - 1)

# Main timeline line
hline(TRACK_LEFT, TRACK_RIGHT, TRACK_Y, GRID, width=4)

BUBBLE_R = 15
WARN_R = 24

for i, (yr, chrome_vers, runs, note, is_warn) in enumerate(years_data):
    cx = TRACK_LEFT + int(i * SPACING)

    # Vertical tick mark
    vline(cx, TRACK_Y - 12, TRACK_Y + 12, GRID, width=2)

    # Year label above timeline
    ctext(cx, TRACK_Y - 48, yr, load(DJ_MONOB, 30), WHITE)

    # Chrome versions
    text((cx, TRACK_Y + 28), chrome_vers, load(DJ_MONO, 22), ACCENT, anchor="mt")

    # Runs badge
    badge_w, badge_h = 68, 36
    badge_color = ACCENT2 if runs == max(y[2] for y in years_data) else ACCENT
    rect(cx - badge_w//2, TRACK_Y + 62, cx + badge_w//2, TRACK_Y + 62 + badge_h, badge_color, radius=8)
    text((cx, TRACK_Y + 62 + badge_h//2), str(runs), load(DJ_MONOB, 26), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    text((cx, TRACK_Y + 62 + badge_h + 6), "runs", load(SANS_R, 17), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_color = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
    ctext(cx, TRACK_Y + 62 + badge_h + 32, note, load(SANS_R, 20), note_color)

    # Warning callout for Chrome 118 (index 4)
    if is_warn:
        warn_w, warn_h = 440, 130
        warn_x = cx - warn_w // 2
        warn_y = TRACK_Y - 210

        rect(warn_x, warn_y, warn_x + warn_w, warn_y + warn_h, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((warn_x, warn_y, warn_x + warn_w, warn_y + warn_h),
                           radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        # Warning triangle
        tri_cx, tri_cy = warn_x + 42, warn_y + warn_h // 2
        s = 20
        d.polygon([(tri_cx, tri_cy - s), (tri_cx + s, tri_cy + int(s*0.7)),
                   (tri_cx - s, tri_cy + int(s*0.7))], fill=WARN)

        text((tri_cx + 48, warn_y + 20), "SCORING METHOD CHANGE", load(SANS_B, 32), WARN)
        text((tri_cx + 48, warn_y + 58), "Arithmetic mean  \u2192  Weighted geometric mean", load(DJ_MONO, 24), WARN)
        text((tri_cx + 48, warn_y + 90), "Cross-version comparisons before/after Chrome 118 are not directly valid", load(SANS_R, 21), WARN_DIM)

        # Connector from warning box to node
        d.line([(cx, warn_y + warn_h), (cx, TRACK_Y - WARN_R)], fill=WARN, width=3)

    # Timeline node dot
    r = WARN_R if is_warn else BUBBLE_R
    fill = WARN if is_warn else ACCENT
    d.ellipse((cx - r, TRACK_Y - r, cx + r, TRACK_Y + r), fill=fill, outline=BG_ALT, width=4)

# Bar chart of runs per year
BAR_MAX_H = 180
BAR_W = 44
BAR_TOP = TRACK_Y + 175
BAR_BOTTOM = BAR_TOP + BAR_MAX_H
bar_vals = [d[2] for d in years_data]
max_runs = max(bar_vals)

# Grid lines for bar chart
for val in [5, 10, 15]:
    gy = BAR_BOTTOM - int((val / max_runs) * BAR_MAX_H)
    hline(TRACK_LEFT - 15, TRACK_RIGHT + 15, gy, (35, 42, 68), width=1)
    text((TRACK_LEFT - 25, gy), str(val), load(DJ_MONO, 20), TEXT_FAINT, anchor="rm")

for i, count in enumerate(bar_vals):
    bx = TRACK_LEFT + int(i * SPACING) - BAR_W // 2
    bar_h = int((count / max_runs) * BAR_MAX_H)
    bar_y = BAR_BOTTOM - bar_h
    color = ACCENT2 if count == max_runs else ACCENT
    if i == 4:
        color = WARN  # highlight 2023 methodology shift year
    rect(bx, bar_y, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, color, radius=6)
    # Value label
    ctext(bx + BAR_W//2, bar_y - 16, str(count), load(DJ_MONOB, 26), WHITE)

# Bar chart axis
hline(TRACK_LEFT - 15, TRACK_RIGHT + 15, BAR_BOTTOM, GRID, width=2)
text((TRACK_LEFT, BAR_BOTTOM + 24), "Runs per year", load(SANS_R, 22), TEXT_FAINT)

# Platform summary row
info_y = BAR_BOTTOM + 60
platform_info = [
    ("macOS (OSX)", "95%+", ACCENT),
    ("Windows", "2 runs only (Chrome 104 & 121)", TEXT_DIM),
    ("Keyed-only", "Odd Chrome versions 139+", ACCENT2),
]
pitem_w = TRACK_W / 3
for pi, (label, val, col) in enumerate(platform_info):
    px = TRACK_LEFT + pi * pitem_w
    text((px, info_y), label, load(SANS_B, 24), col)
    text((px, info_y + 30), val, load(SANS_R, 22), TEXT_DIM)

Y = TL_BOTTOM + 60

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METHODOLOGY SECTION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
section_accent(ML, Y, WARN)
text((ML + 30, Y - 2), "Methodology Milestones", load(SANS_B, 64), WHITE)
text((ML + 30, Y + 68), "Why comparing results across Chrome versions can be misleading",
     load(SANS_R, 32), TEXT_DIM)
Y += 130

METH_W = (INNER_W - 80) // 3
METH_H = 300

method_items = [
    {
        "num": "01", "title": "Scoring Method Changed",
        "when": "Chrome 118, 2023",
        "desc": "Overall score switched from arithmetic mean to weighted geometric mean. This is the single biggest reason cross-version comparisons are invalid.",
        "color": WARN,
    },
    {
        "num": "02", "title": "CPU Throttling Recalibrated",
        "when": "Chrome 118, 2023",
        "desc": "Throttling factors were adjusted for more realistic load simulation, changing the performance baseline for all framework measurements.",
        "color": ACCENT2,
    },
    {
        "num": "03", "title": "Ongoing Instrumentation Refinements",
        "when": "Chrome 118+ to present",
        "desc": "Continuous improvements to timing precision, driver instrumentation, and measurement accuracy. Each run may differ in subtle ways.",
        "color": ACCENT,
    },
]

for i, item in enumerate(method_items):
    mx = ML + i * (METH_W + 40)
    rect(mx, Y, mx + METH_W, Y + METH_H, BG_ALT, radius=22)
    d.rounded_rectangle((mx, Y, mx + METH_W, Y + METH_H), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

    # Large number watermark
    text((mx + METH_W - 50, Y + 20), item["num"], load(DJ_MONOB, 70), (25, 32, 55), anchor="ra")

    # Accent bar
    rect(mx + 30, Y + 90, mx + 130, Y + 96, item["color"], radius=3)

    # Title
    text((mx + 30, Y + 120), item["title"], load(SANS_B, 36), WHITE)
    # When
    text((mx + 30, Y + 165), item["when"], load(DJ_MONO, 24), item["color"])
    # Desc
    draw_wrapped(mx + 30, Y + 205, item["desc"], load(SANS_R, 26), TEXT_DIM, METH_W - 60, 32)

Y += METH_H + 50

# ── Bold warning banner ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
WARN_BAR_H = 110
rect(ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_BAR_H, WARN_BG, radius=16)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_BAR_H), radius=16, outline=WARN, width=3)

tri_cx, tri_cy = ML + 55, Y + WARN_BAR_H // 2
s = 22
d.polygon([(tri_cx, tri_cy - s), (tri_cx + s, tri_cy + int(s*0.7)),
           (tri_cx - s, tri_cy + int(s*0.7))], fill=WARN)

text((tri_cx + 65, tri_cy), "\u26A0  Cross-version comparisons are unreliable \u2014 always compare benchmark results within the same Chrome version",
     load(SANS_B, 32), WARN, anchor="lm")

Y += WARN_BAR_H + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
section_accent(ML, Y, ACCENT2)
text((ML + 30, Y - 2), "Key Takeaways for Developers", load(SANS_B, 64), WHITE)
Y += 100

TK_W = (INNER_W - 80) // 5
TK_H = 370

takeaways = [
    {"num": "01", "line1": "Compare within the", "line2": "same Chrome version",
     "desc": "Methodology, throttling, and scoring differ across releases.", "color": ACCENT},
    {"num": "02", "line1": "Consult the", "line2": "latest run (Chrome 146)",
     "desc": "Most up-to-date framework performance standings.", "color": ACCENT2},
    {"num": "03", "line1": "Understand keyed vs", "line2": "non-keyed modes",
     "desc": "Odd Chrome versions (139+) test keyed frameworks only.", "color": WARN},
    {"num": "04", "line1": "60+ data points", "line2": "over 8 years",
     "desc": "Longest-running comprehensive JS framework performance tracker.", "color": ACCENT},
    {"num": "05", "line1": "Weighted geometric mean", "line2": "since Chrome 118",

]

for i, tk in enumerate(takeaways):
    tx = ML + i * (TK_W + 20)
    rect(tx, Y, tx + TK_W, Y + TK_H, BG_ALT, radius=22)
    d.rounded_rectangle((tx, Y, tx + TK_W, Y + TK_H), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
DPI = 150

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
BG_PANEL  = (22, 28, 50)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
GRID_LT   = (40, 48, 72)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT_D  = (0, 150, 200)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
ACCENT2_D = (15, 140, 125)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 12)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout params ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 160, 120
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML
CX = W // 2

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
DS   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DSB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def txt(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        txt((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent_color):
    rrect(x, y - 8, x + 6, y + 52, accent_color, radius=3)
    txt((x + 28, y - 8), title, fnt(S_B, 64), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        txt((x + 28, y + 62), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 105
    return y + 70

def card(x, y, w, h, accent_color=None):
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=18)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=18, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent_color:
        rrect(x + 28, y + 22, x + 100, y + 28, accent_color, radius=3)

def warn_triangle(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = MT + 40

# Title section
rrect(ML, Y - 8, ML + 8, Y + 160, ACCENT, radius=4)
txt((ML + 36, Y - 4), "JS Framework Benchmark", fnt(S_B, 128), WHITE)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 130), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", fnt(S_B, 48), ACCENT2)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 188), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
    fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 280

# Hero stat cards
HERO_W = (INNER_W - 100) // 3
HERO_H = 300

heroes = [
    ("60+", "Official Benchmark Runs", "Published since 2017", ACCENT),
    ("55 \u2192 146", "Chrome Versions Covered", "Spanning ~8 years of browser releases", ACCENT2),
    ("Chrome 118", "Major Methodology Shift", "Scoring method fundamentally changed", WARN),
]

hero_x = [ML + i * (HERO_W + 50) for i in range(3)]
for i, (num, label, sub, color) in enumerate(heroes):
    hx = hero_x[i]
    card(hx, Y, HERO_W, HERO_H, color)

    nf = fnt(DMB, 96) if i < 2 else fnt(DMB, 48)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 55), num, nf, color)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 170), label, fnt(S_B, 34), WHITE)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 218), sub, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

    # Bottom accent line
    rrect(hx + 32, Y + HERO_H - 24, hx + HERO_W - 32, Y + HERO_H - 18, color, radius=2)

Y += HERO_H + 80

# Decorative divider
hline(ML + INNER_W // 4, ML + 3 * INNER_W // 4, Y, GRID, width=1)
Y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. TIMELINE — THE CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Benchmark Timeline", "60+ official result sets across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026", ACCENT)

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1340
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rrect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

# Data
years = [
    ("2017\u2013\n2019",  "55, 58,\n62, 69",    4,  "Early era;\nstefankrause.net",   False),
    ("2020",               "83 \u2013 87",         5,  "Migrated to\nGitHub Pages",      False),
    ("2021",               "88 \u2013 96",         9,  "Steady monthly\ncadence",         False),
    ("2022",               "97 \u2013 108",       13,  "Peak year;\n2 Windows runs",      False),
    ("2023",               "109 \u2013 120",      12,  "Methodology\noverhaul at 118",    True),
    ("2024",               "121 \u2013 131",      12,  "Stable;\n1 Windows run",          False),
    ("2025",               "132 \u2013 143",      12,  "Keyed-only\nalternating",         False),
    ("2026",               "144 \u2013 146",       3,  "Latest: Chrome\n146 on macOS",    False),
]

n = len(years)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 100
TRACK_L = ML + 120
TRACK_R = RIGHT - 80
TRACK_W = TRACK_R - TRACK_L
SPACING = TRACK_W / (n - 1)
max_run = 13

# Main timeline
hline(TRACK_L, TRACK_R, TRACK_Y, GRID, width=5)

B_R, W_R = 15, 26

for i, (yr_label, chrome, runs, note, is_warn) in enumerate(years):
    cx = TRACK_L + int(i * SPACING)

    # Tick
    vline(cx, TRACK_Y - 14, TRACK_Y + 14, GRID, width=2)

    # Year label (multi-line)
    yr_lines = yr_label.split("\n")
    yy = TRACK_Y - 58
    for line in yr_lines:
        ctx(cx, yy, line, fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)
        yy += 30

    # Chrome versions
    ch_lines = chrome.split("\n")
    cy = TRACK_Y + 36
    for line in ch_lines:
        ctx(cx, cy, line, fnt(DM, 22), ACCENT)
        cy += 26

    # Runs badge
    badge_sz = 62
    badge_y = cy + 6
    bcolor = ACCENT2 if runs == max_run else ACCENT
    if is_warn:
        bcolor = WARN
    rrect(cx - badge_sz//2, badge_y, cx + badge_sz//2, badge_y + 34, bcolor, radius=8)
    txt((cx, badge_y + 17), str(runs), fnt(DMB, 24), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    txt((cx, badge_y + 40), "runs", fnt(S_R, 16), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_y = badge_y + 64
    for line in note.split("\n"):
        nc = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
        ctx(cx, note_y, line, fnt(S_R, 20), nc)
        note_y += 22

    # WARNING CALLOUT (index 4 = 2023 / Chrome 118)
    if is_warn:
        ww, wh = 430, 135
        wx = cx - ww // 2
        wy = TRACK_Y - 225

        rrect(wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh), radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        warn_triangle(wx + 44, wy + wh // 2, 20, WARN)

        txt((wx + 80, wy + 18), "METHODOLOGY SHIFT", fnt(S_B, 32), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 58), "Arithmetic mean \u2192 Weighted geometric mean", fnt(DM, 24), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 94), "Comparisons across Chrome 118 are not directly valid", fnt(S_R, 21), WARN_D)

        # Connector
        d.line([(cx, wy + wh), (cx, TRACK_Y - W_R)], fill=WARN, width=3)

        # Side annotation
        if i + 1 < n:
            nx = TRACK_L + int((i+1) * SPACING) - 22
            for j, line in enumerate(["Cross-version", "comparisons before", "and after Chrome 118", "are NOT safe."]):
                txt((nx, wy + 6 + j * 24), line, fnt(S_R, 20), RED)

    r = W_R if is_warn else B_R
    fill = WARN if is_warn else ACCENT
    d.ellipse((cx - r, TRACK_Y - r, cx + r, TRACK_Y + r), fill=fill, outline=BG_ALT, width=5)

# ── Bar chart section ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BAR_MAX_H = 200
BAR_W = 46
BAR_TOP = TRACK_Y + 230
BAR_BOTTOM = BAR_TOP + BAR_MAX_H
bar_vals = [d[2] for d in years]

for i, count in enumerate(bar_vals):

    if years[i][4]:  # warn year

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def txt(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        txt((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent_color):
    rrect(x, y - 8, x + 6, y + 52, accent_color, radius=3)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
DPI = 150

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
BG_PANEL  = (22, 28, 50)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
GRID_LT   = (40, 48, 72)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT_D  = (0, 150, 200)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
ACCENT2_D = (15, 140, 125)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 12)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout params ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 160, 120
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML
CX = W // 2

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
DS   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DSB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def txt(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        txt((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent_color):
    rrect(x, y - 8, x + 6, y + 52, accent_color, radius=3)
    txt((x + 28, y - 8), title, fnt(S_B, 64), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        txt((x + 28, y + 62), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 105
    return y + 70

def card(x, y, w, h, accent_color=None):
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=18)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=18, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent_color:
        rrect(x + 28, y + 22, x + 100, y + 28, accent_color, radius=3)

def warn_triangle(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = MT + 40

# Title section
rrect(ML, Y - 8, ML + 8, Y + 160, ACCENT, radius=4)
txt((ML + 36, Y - 4), "JS Framework Benchmark", fnt(S_B, 128), WHITE)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 130), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", fnt(S_B, 48), ACCENT2)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 188), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
    fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 280

# Hero stat cards
HERO_W = (INNER_W - 100) // 3
HERO_H = 300

heroes = [
    ("60+", "Official Benchmark Runs", "Published since 2017", ACCENT),
    ("55 \u2192 146", "Chrome Versions Covered", "Spanning ~8 years of browser releases", ACCENT2),
    ("Chrome 118", "Major Methodology Shift", "Scoring method fundamentally changed", WARN),
]

hero_x = [ML + i * (HERO_W + 50) for i in range(3)]
for i, (num, label, sub, color) in enumerate(heroes):
    hx = hero_x[i]
    card(hx, Y, HERO_W, HERO_H, color)

    nf = fnt(DMB, 96) if i < 2 else fnt(DMB, 48)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 55), num, nf, color)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 170), label, fnt(S_B, 34), WHITE)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 218), sub, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

    # Bottom accent line
    rrect(hx + 32, Y + HERO_H - 24, hx + HERO_W - 32, Y + HERO_H - 18, color, radius=2)

Y += HERO_H + 80

# Decorative divider
hline(ML + INNER_W // 4, ML + 3 * INNER_W // 4, Y, GRID, width=1)
Y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. TIMELINE — THE CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Benchmark Timeline", "60+ official result sets across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026", ACCENT)

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1340
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rrect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

# Data
years = [
    ("2017\u2013\n2019",  "55, 58,\n62, 69",    4,  "Early era;\nstefankrause.net",   False),
    ("2020",               "83 \u2013 87",         5,  "Migrated to\nGitHub Pages",      False),
    ("2021",               "88 \u2013 96",         9,  "Steady monthly\ncadence",         False),
    ("2022",               "97 \u2013 108",       13,  "Peak year;\n2 Windows runs",      False),
    ("2023",               "109 \u2013 120",      12,  "Methodology\noverhaul at 118",    True),
    ("2024",               "121 \u2013 131",      12,  "Stable;\n1 Windows run",          False),
    ("2025",               "132 \u2013 143",      12,  "Keyed-only\nalternating",         False),
    ("2026",               "144 \u2013 146",       3,  "Latest: Chrome\n146 on macOS",    False),
]

n = len(years)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 100
TRACK_L = ML + 120
TRACK_R = RIGHT - 80
TRACK_W = TRACK_R - TRACK_L
SPACING = TRACK_W / (n - 1)
max_run = 13

# Main timeline
hline(TRACK_L, TRACK_R, TRACK_Y, GRID, width=5)

B_R, W_R = 15, 26

for i, (yr_label, chrome, runs, note, is_warn) in enumerate(years):
    cx = TRACK_L + int(i * SPACING)

    # Tick
    vline(cx, TRACK_Y - 14, TRACK_Y + 14, GRID, width=2)

    # Year label (multi-line)
    yr_lines = yr_label.split("\n")
    yy = TRACK_Y - 58
    for line in yr_lines:
        ctx(cx, yy, line, fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)
        yy += 30

    # Chrome versions
    ch_lines = chrome.split("\n")
    cy = TRACK_Y + 36
    for line in ch_lines:
        ctx(cx, cy, line, fnt(DM, 22), ACCENT)
        cy += 26

    # Runs badge
    badge_sz = 62
    badge_y = cy + 6
    bcolor = ACCENT2 if runs == max_run else ACCENT
    if is_warn:
        bcolor = WARN
    rrect(cx - badge_sz//2, badge_y, cx + badge_sz//2, badge_y + 34, bcolor, radius=8)
    txt((cx, badge_y + 17), str(runs), fnt(DMB, 24), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    txt((cx, badge_y + 40), "runs", fnt(S_R, 16), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_y = badge_y + 64
    for line in note.split("\n"):
        nc = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
        ctx(cx, note_y, line, fnt(S_R, 20), nc)
        note_y += 22

    # WARNING CALLOUT (index 4 = 2023 / Chrome 118)
    if is_warn:
        ww, wh = 430, 135
        wx = cx - ww // 2
        wy = TRACK_Y - 225

        rrect(wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh), radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        warn_triangle(wx + 44, wy + wh // 2, 20, WARN)

        txt((wx + 80, wy + 18), "METHODOLOGY SHIFT", fnt(S_B, 32), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 58), "Arithmetic mean \u2192 Weighted geometric mean", fnt(DM, 24), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 94), "Comparisons across Chrome 118 are not directly valid", fnt(S_R, 21), WARN_D)

        # Connector
        d.line([(cx, wy + wh), (cx, TRACK_Y - W_R)], fill=WARN, width=3)

        # Side annotation
        if i + 1 < n:
            nx = TRACK_L + int((i+1) * SPACING) - 22
            for j, line in enumerate(["Cross-version", "comparisons before", "and after Chrome 118", "are NOT safe."]):
                txt((nx, wy + 6 + j * 24), line, fnt(S_R, 20), RED)

    # Timeline node
    r = W_R if is_warn else B_R
    fill = WARN if is_warn else ACCENT
    d.ellipse((cx - r, TRACK_Y - r, cx + r, TRACK_Y + r), fill=fill, outline=BG_ALT, width=5)

# ── Bar chart section ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BAR_MAX_H = 200
BAR_W = 46
BAR_TOP = TRACK_Y + 230
BAR_BOTTOM = BAR_TOP + BAR_MAX_H
bar_vals = [d[2] for d in years]

# Grid
for val in [5, 10, 15]:
    gy = BAR_BOTTOM - int((val / max_run) * BAR_MAX_H)
    hline(TRACK_L - 15, TRACK_R + 15, gy, (35, 42, 68), width=1)
    txt((TRACK_L - 22, gy), str(val), fnt(DM, 20), TEXT_FAINT, anchor="rm")

for i, count in enumerate(bar_vals):
    bx = TRACK_L + int(i * SPACING) - BAR_W // 2
    bar_h = int((count / max_run) * BAR_MAX_H)
    by = BAR_BOTTOM - bar_h
    if years[i][4]:  # warn year
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, WARN, radius=6)
    elif count == max_run:
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, ACCENT2, radius=6)
    else:
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, ACCENT, radius=6)
    ctx(bx + BAR_W//2, by - 16, str(count), fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)

hline(TRACK_L - 15, TRACK_R + 15, BAR_BOTTOM, GRID, width=2)
txt((TRACK_L, BAR_BOTTOM + 22), "Runs per year", fnt(S_B, 22), TEXT_FAINT)

# ── Platform summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PLAT_Y = BAR_BOTTOM + 65
pi = 0
for label, val, color in [
    ("Platform", "95%+ macOS (OSX)", ACCENT),
    ("Windows", "Only 2 runs (Chrome 104 & 121)", TEXT_DIM),
    ("Mode", "Keyed-only since Chrome 139+", ACCENT2),
]:
    px = TRACK_L + pi * (TRACK_W / 3)
    txt((px, PLAT_Y), label, fnt(S_B, 24), color)
    txt((px, PLAT_Y + 30), val, fnt(S_R, 22), TEXT_DIM)
    pi += 1

Y = TL_BOTTOM + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. METHODOLOGY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Methodology Milestones",
             "Why comparing results across Chrome versions can be misleading", WARN)

METH_W = (INNER_W - 80) // 3
METH_H = 330

meth = [
    ("01", "Scoring Method Changed", "Chrome 118, 2023",
     "Overall score switched from arithmetic mean to weighted geometric mean. This single change is the most important reason cross-version comparisons are invalid.",
     WARN),
    ("02", "CPU Throttling Recalibrated", "Chrome 118, 2023",
     "Throttling factors were adjusted for more realistic load simulation, effectively changing the performance baseline for every framework.",
     ACCENT2),
    ("03", "Ongoing Instrumentation Refinements", "Chrome 118+ to present",
     "Continuous improvements to timing precision, driver instrumentation, and measurement accuracy mean each run may differ in subtle technical ways.",
     ACCENT),
]

for i, (num, title, when, desc, color) in enumerate(meth):
    mx = ML + i * (METH_W + 40)
    card(mx, Y, METH_W, METH_H, color)

    # Large number
    txt((mx + METH_W - 55, Y + 18), num, fnt(DMB, 72), (25, 33, 58), anchor="ra")

    # Title
    txt((mx + 32, Y + 105), title, fnt(S_B, 36), WHITE)
    # When
    txt((mx + 32, Y + 155), when, fnt(DM, 24), color)
    # Description
    dwrap(mx + 32, Y + 200, desc, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM, METH_W - 64, 32)

Y += METH_H + 50

# Warning banner
WARN_H = 120
rrect(ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_H, WARN_BG, radius=16)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_H), radius=16, outline=WARN, width=3)

warn_triangle(ML + 58, Y + WARN_H // 2, 22, WARN)
txt((ML + 105, Y + WARN_H // 2),
    "\u26A0  Cross-version comparisons are unreliable \u2014 always compare within the same Chrome version",
    fnt(S_B, 33), WARN, anchor="lm")

Y += WARN_H + 80

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. KEY TAKEAWAYS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Key Takeaways for Developers", None, ACCENT2)

TK_W = (INNER_W - 80) // 5
TK_H = 400

    ("04", "60+ data points", "over 8 years",

    ("05", "Weighted geometric mean", "since Chrome 118",
     "Provides more balanced overall scoring than the previous arithmetic mean approach.", ACCENT),
]

    card(tx, Y, TK_W, TK_H, color)

    # Big number
    txt((tx + 30, Y + 48), num, fnt(DMB, 64), color)
    # Line 1
    txt((tx + 30, Y + 135), l1, fnt(S_B, 28), WHITE)
    # Line 2 (accented)
    txt((tx + 30, Y + 170), l2, fnt(DMB, 22), color)
    # Description
    dwrap(tx + 30, Y + 220, desc, fnt(S_R, 22), TEXT_DIM, TK_W - 60, 28)

Y += TK_H + 90

hline(ML, RIGHT, FOOTER_Y + 3, (25, 30, 50), width=1)

txt((RIGHT, FOOTER_Y + 40), "Data through Chrome 146 (May 2026)  \u00b7  A1 Portrait @ 150 DPI",

# Right edge accent
rrect(RIGHT + 20, MT, RIGHT + 22, FOOTER_Y, ACCENT)

os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(path, "PNG", optimize=True)
sz = os.path.getsize(path) / 1024

print(f"Size: {W}x{H}px @ {DPI} DPI | {sz:.0f} KB")
print(f"Content Y range: {MT} to {Y}, Footer at {FOOTER_Y}")
print(f"Fill: {(Y / H * 100):.0f}%")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
DPI = 150

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
BG_PANEL  = (22, 28, 50)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
GRID_LT   = (40, 48, 72)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT_D  = (0, 150, 200)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
ACCENT2_D = (15, 140, 125)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 12)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout params ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 160, 120
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML
CX = W // 2

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
DS   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DSB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def txt(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        txt((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent_color):
    rrect(x, y - 8, x + 6, y + 52, accent_color, radius=3)
    txt((x + 28, y - 8), title, fnt(S_B, 64), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        txt((x + 28, y + 62), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 105
    return y + 70

def card(x, y, w, h, accent_color=None):
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=18)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=18, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent_color:
        rrect(x + 28, y + 22, x + 100, y + 28, accent_color, radius=3)

def warn_triangle(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = MT + 40

# Title section
rrect(ML, Y - 8, ML + 8, Y + 160, ACCENT, radius=4)
txt((ML + 36, Y - 4), "JS Framework Benchmark", fnt(S_B, 128), WHITE)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 130), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", fnt(S_B, 48), ACCENT2)
txt((ML + 36, Y + 188), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
    fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 280

# Hero stat cards
HERO_W = (INNER_W - 100) // 3
HERO_H = 300

heroes = [
    ("60+", "Official Benchmark Runs", "Published since 2017", ACCENT),
    ("55 \u2192 146", "Chrome Versions Covered", "Spanning ~8 years of browser releases", ACCENT2),
    ("Chrome 118", "Major Methodology Shift", "Scoring method fundamentally changed", WARN),
]

hero_x = [ML + i * (HERO_W + 50) for i in range(3)]
for i, (num, label, sub, color) in enumerate(heroes):
    hx = hero_x[i]
    card(hx, Y, HERO_W, HERO_H, color)

    nf = fnt(DMB, 96) if i < 2 else fnt(DMB, 48)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 55), num, nf, color)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 170), label, fnt(S_B, 34), WHITE)
    txt((hx + 32, Y + 218), sub, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

    # Bottom accent line
    rrect(hx + 32, Y + HERO_H - 24, hx + HERO_W - 32, Y + HERO_H - 18, color, radius=2)

Y += HERO_H + 80

# Decorative divider
hline(ML + INNER_W // 4, ML + 3 * INNER_W // 4, Y, GRID, width=1)
Y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. TIMELINE — THE CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Benchmark Timeline", "60+ official result sets across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026", ACCENT)

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1340
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rrect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

# Data
years = [
    ("2017\u2013\n2019",  "55, 58,\n62, 69",    4,  "Early era;\nstefankrause.net",   False),
    ("2020",               "83 \u2013 87",         5,  "Migrated to\nGitHub Pages",      False),
    ("2021",               "88 \u2013 96",         9,  "Steady monthly\ncadence",         False),
    ("2022",               "97 \u2013 108",       13,  "Peak year;\n2 Windows runs",      False),
    ("2023",               "109 \u2013 120",      12,  "Methodology\noverhaul at 118",    True),
    ("2024",               "121 \u2013 131",      12,  "Stable;\n1 Windows run",          False),
    ("2025",               "132 \u2013 143",      12,  "Keyed-only\nalternating",         False),
    ("2026",               "144 \u2013 146",       3,  "Latest: Chrome\n146 on macOS",    False),
]

n = len(years)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 100
TRACK_L = ML + 120
TRACK_R = RIGHT - 80
TRACK_W = TRACK_R - TRACK_L
SPACING = TRACK_W / (n - 1)
max_run = 13

# Main timeline
hline(TRACK_L, TRACK_R, TRACK_Y, GRID, width=5)

B_R, W_R = 15, 26

for i, (yr_label, chrome, runs, note, is_warn) in enumerate(years):
    cx = TRACK_L + int(i * SPACING)

    # Tick
    vline(cx, TRACK_Y - 14, TRACK_Y + 14, GRID, width=2)

    # Year label (multi-line)
    yr_lines = yr_label.split("\n")
    yy = TRACK_Y - 58
    for line in yr_lines:
        ctx(cx, yy, line, fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)
        yy += 30

    # Chrome versions
    ch_lines = chrome.split("\n")
    cy = TRACK_Y + 36
    for line in ch_lines:
        ctx(cx, cy, line, fnt(DM, 22), ACCENT)
        cy += 26

    # Runs badge
    badge_sz = 62
    badge_y = cy + 6
    bcolor = ACCENT2 if runs == max_run else ACCENT
    if is_warn:
        bcolor = WARN
    rrect(cx - badge_sz//2, badge_y, cx + badge_sz//2, badge_y + 34, bcolor, radius=8)
    txt((cx, badge_y + 17), str(runs), fnt(DMB, 24), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    txt((cx, badge_y + 40), "runs", fnt(S_R, 16), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_y = badge_y + 64
    for line in note.split("\n"):
        nc = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
        ctx(cx, note_y, line, fnt(S_R, 20), nc)
        note_y += 22

    # WARNING CALLOUT (index 4 = 2023 / Chrome 118)
    if is_warn:
        ww, wh = 430, 135
        wx = cx - ww // 2
        wy = TRACK_Y - 225

        rrect(wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh), radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        warn_triangle(wx + 44, wy + wh // 2, 20, WARN)

        txt((wx + 80, wy + 18), "METHODOLOGY SHIFT", fnt(S_B, 32), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 58), "Arithmetic mean \u2192 Weighted geometric mean", fnt(DM, 24), WARN)
        txt((wx + 80, wy + 94), "Comparisons across Chrome 118 are not directly valid", fnt(S_R, 21), WARN_D)

        # Connector
        d.line([(cx, wy + wh), (cx, TRACK_Y - W_R)], fill=WARN, width=3)

        # Side annotation
        if i + 1 < n:
            nx = TRACK_L + int((i+1) * SPACING) - 22
            for j, line in enumerate(["Cross-version", "comparisons before", "and after Chrome 118", "are NOT safe."]):
                txt((nx, wy + 6 + j * 24), line, fnt(S_R, 20), RED)

    # Timeline node
    r = W_R if is_warn else B_R
    fill = WARN if is_warn else ACCENT
    d.ellipse((cx - r, TRACK_Y - r, cx + r, TRACK_Y + r), fill=fill, outline=BG_ALT, width=5)

BAR_MAX_H = 200
BAR_W = 46
BAR_TOP = TRACK_Y + 230
BAR_BOTTOM = BAR_TOP + BAR_MAX_H
bar_vals = [d[2] for d in years]

# Grid
for val in [5, 10, 15]:
    gy = BAR_BOTTOM - int((val / max_run) * BAR_MAX_H)
    hline(TRACK_L - 15, TRACK_R + 15, gy, (35, 42, 68), width=1)
    txt((TRACK_L - 22, gy), str(val), fnt(DM, 20), TEXT_FAINT, anchor="rm")

for i, count in enumerate(bar_vals):

    bar_h = int((count / max_run) * BAR_MAX_H)
    by = BAR_BOTTOM - bar_h
    if years[i][4]:  # warn year
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, WARN, radius=6)
    elif count == max_run:
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, ACCENT2, radius=6)
    else:
        rrect(bx, by, bx + BAR_W, BAR_BOTTOM, ACCENT, radius=6)
    ctx(bx + BAR_W//2, by - 16, str(count), fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)

txt((TRACK_L, BAR_BOTTOM + 22), "Runs per year", fnt(S_B, 22), TEXT_FAINT)

# ── Platform summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PLAT_Y = BAR_BOTTOM + 65
pi = 0
for label, val, color in [
    ("Platform", "95%+ macOS (OSX)", ACCENT),
    ("Windows", "Only 2 runs (Chrome 104 & 121)", TEXT_DIM),
    ("Mode", "Keyed-only since Chrome 139+", ACCENT2),
]:
    px = TRACK_L + pi * (TRACK_W / 3)
    txt((px, PLAT_Y), label, fnt(S_B, 24), color)
    txt((px, PLAT_Y + 30), val, fnt(S_R, 22), TEXT_DIM)
    pi += 1

Y = TL_BOTTOM + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

     WARN),
    ("02", "CPU Throttling Recalibrated", "Chrome 118, 2023",
     "Throttling factors were adjusted for more realistic load simulation, effectively changing the performance baseline for every framework.",
     ACCENT2),
    ("03", "Ongoing Instrumentation Refinements", "Chrome 118+ to present",

     ACCENT),
]

for i, (num, title, when, desc, color) in enumerate(meth):
    mx = ML + i * (METH_W + 40)
    card(mx, Y, METH_W, METH_H, color)

    # Large number
    txt((mx + METH_W - 55, Y + 18), num, fnt(DMB, 72), (25, 33, 58), anchor="ra")

    # Title
    txt((mx + 32, Y + 105), title, fnt(S_B, 36), WHITE)
    # When
    txt((mx + 32, Y + 155), when, fnt(DM, 24), color)
    # Description
    dwrap(mx + 32, Y + 200, desc, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM, METH_W - 64, 32)

Y += METH_H + 50

# Warning banner
WARN_H = 120
rrect(ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_H, WARN_BG, radius=16)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, Y, RIGHT, Y + WARN_H), radius=16, outline=WARN, width=3)

warn_triangle(ML + 58, Y + WARN_H // 2, 22, WARN)
txt((ML + 105, Y + WARN_H // 2),
    "\u26A0  Cross-version comparisons are unreliable \u2014 always compare within the same Chrome version",
    fnt(S_B, 33), WARN, anchor="lm")

Y += WARN_H + 80

# 4. KEY TAKEAWAYS

TK_H = 400

tks = [

     "Methodology, throttling, and scoring methods differ across releases.", ACCENT),
    ("02", "Consult the", "latest run (Chrome 146)",
     "Always refer to the most recent run for current framework standings.", ACCENT2),
    ("03", "Understand", "keyed vs non-keyed",
     "Odd Chrome versions (139+) benchmark keyed frameworks only. Even versions include both.", WARN),
    ("04", "60+ data points", "over 8 years",
     "The longest-running and most comprehensive JS framework performance tracker available.", PURPLE),
    ("05", "Weighted geometric mean", "since Chrome 118",

    txt((tx + 30, Y + 135), l1, fnt(S_B, 28), WHITE)
    # Line 2 (accented)
    txt((tx + 30, Y + 170), l2, fnt(DMB, 22), color)
    # Description
    dwrap(tx + 30, Y + 220, desc, fnt(S_R, 22), TEXT_DIM, TK_W - 60, 28)

hline(ML, RIGHT, FOOTER_Y + 3, (25, 30, 50), width=1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
DPI = 150

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
BG_PANEL  = (22, 28, 50)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
GRID_LT   = (40, 48, 72)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT_D  = (0, 150, 200)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
ACCENT2_D = (15, 140, 125)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 12)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout params ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 160, 120
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML
CX = W // 2

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
DS   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DSB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def txt(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        txt((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic.
Fills ~90% of the canvas with content, leaving breathing room at top and bottom."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 10)
RED       = (239, 68, 68)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 150, 110
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML

# Available vertical space to fill
CONTENT_TOP = MT + 30
CONTENT_BOT = H - MB - 120   # leave room for footer
AVAIL_H = CONTENT_BOT - CONTENT_TOP   # ~4567px to fill

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid background
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def t(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    """Center text horizontally & vertically at (x,y)."""
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic.
Fills ~90% of the canvas with content, leaving breathing room at top and bottom."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 10)
RED       = (239, 68, 68)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 150, 110
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML

# Available vertical space to fill
CONTENT_TOP = MT + 30
CONTENT_BOT = H - MB - 120   # leave room for footer
AVAIL_H = CONTENT_BOT - CONTENT_TOP   # ~4567px to fill

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid background
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def t(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    """Center text horizontally & vertically at (x,y)."""
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    """Draw wrapped text; return next y."""
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        t((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent):
    """Section header with accent bar. Returns y after header."""
    rrect(x, y, x + 8, y + 58, accent, radius=4)
    t((x + 32, y - 4), title, fnt(S_B, 68), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        t((x + 32, y + 72), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 120
    return y + 80

def draw_card(x, y, w, h, accent=None):
    """Card with background, border, optional accent stripe."""
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=20)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=20, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent:
        rrect(x + 30, y + 24, x + 110, y + 30, accent, radius=3)

def warn_tri(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

def divider(y):
    hline(ML + INNER_W//4, ML + 3*INNER_W//4, y, GRID, width=1)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = CONTENT_TOP

# Title
rrect(ML, Y, ML + 8, Y + 170, ACCENT, radius=4)
t((ML + 36, Y), "JS Framework Benchmark", fnt(S_B, 132), WHITE)
t((ML + 36, Y + 140), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", fnt(S_B, 50), ACCENT2)
t((ML + 36, Y + 200), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
  fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 300

# ── Hero stat cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HERO_W = (INNER_W - 100) // 3
HERO_H = 340
HERO_GAP = 50

heroes = [
    ("60+", "Official Benchmark Runs", "Published since 2017", ACCENT),
    ("55 \u2192 146", "Chrome Versions Covered", "Spanning ~8 years of browser releases", ACCENT2),
    ("Chrome 118", "Major Methodology Shift", "Scoring method fundamentally changed", WARN),
]

for i, (num, label, sub, color) in enumerate(heroes):
    hx = ML + i * (HERO_W + HERO_GAP)
    draw_card(hx, Y, HERO_W, HERO_H, color)

    nf = fnt(DMB, 100) if i < 2 else fnt(DMB, 48)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 55), num, nf, color)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 170), label, fnt(S_B, 36), WHITE)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 222), sub, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

    # Bottom accent line
    rrect(hx + 35, Y + HERO_H - 28, hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + HERO_H - 22, color, radius=2)

    # Right-side stat highlight for first two cards
    if i == 0:
        t((hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + 58), "\u2605", fnt(DM, 28), ACCENT, anchor="ra")
    if i == 1:
        t((hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + 58), "\u2194", fnt(DM, 28), ACCENT2, anchor="ra")

Y += HERO_H + 70

divider(Y)
Y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. TIMELINE — CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Benchmark Timeline",
             "60+ official result sets across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026", ACCENT)

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1400
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rrect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

years = [
    ("2017\u2013\n2019",  "55, 58,\n62, 69",    4,  "Early era;\nstefankrause.net",   False),
    ("2020",               "83 \u2013 87",         5,  "Migrated to\nGitHub Pages",      False),
    ("2021",               "88 \u2013 96",         9,  "Steady monthly\ncadence",         False),
    ("2022",               "97 \u2013 108",       13,  "Peak year;\n2 Windows runs",      False),
    ("2023",               "109 \u2013 120",      12,  "Methodology\noverhaul at 118",    True),
    ("2024",               "121 \u2013 131",      12,  "Stable;\n1 Windows run",          False),
    ("2025",               "132 \u2013 143",      12,  "Keyed-only\nalternating",         False),
    ("2026",               "144 \u2013 146",       3,  "Latest: Chrome\n146 on macOS",    False),
]

n = len(years)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 115
TRACK_L = ML + 120
TRACK_R = RIGHT - 80
TRACK_W = TRACK_R - TRACK_L
SPACING = TRACK_W / (n - 1)
max_run = 13

# Main timeline line
hline(TRACK_L, TRACK_R, TRACK_Y, GRID, width=5)

for i, (yr_label, chrome, runs, note, is_warn) in enumerate(years):
    cx = TRACK_L + int(i * SPACING)

    # Tick
    vline(cx, TRACK_Y - 14, TRACK_Y + 14, GRID, width=2)

    # Year label
    yr_lines = yr_label.split("\n")
    yy = TRACK_Y - 62
    for line in yr_lines:
        ctx(cx, yy, line, fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE)
        yy += 30

    # Chrome versions
    ch_lines = chrome.split("\n")
    cy = TRACK_Y + 38
    for line in ch_lines:
        ctx(cx, cy, line, fnt(DM, 22), ACCENT)
        cy += 26

    # Runs badge
    badge_sz = 64
    badge_y = cy + 8
    bcolor = ACCENT2 if runs == max_run else ACCENT
    if is_warn: bcolor = WARN
    rrect(cx - badge_sz//2, badge_y, cx + badge_sz//2, badge_y + 36, bcolor, radius=9)
    t((cx, badge_y + 18), str(runs), fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    t((cx, badge_y + 43), "runs", fnt(S_R, 17), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_y = badge_y + 68
    for line in note.split("\n"):
        nc = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
        ctx(cx, note_y, line, fnt(S_R, 20), nc)
        note_y += 22

    # Warning callout for Chrome 118
    if is_warn:
        ww, wh = 450, 140
        wx = cx - ww // 2
        wy = TRACK_Y - 240

        rrect(wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh), radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        warn_tri(wx + 44, wy + wh // 2, 22, WARN)

        t((wx + 85, wy + 18), "METHODOLOGY SHIFT", fnt(S_B, 34), WARN)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic.
Fills ~90% of the canvas with content, leaving breathing room at top and bottom."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 10)
RED       = (239, 68, 68)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 150, 110
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML

# Available vertical space to fill
CONTENT_TOP = MT + 30
CONTENT_BOT = H - MB - 120   # leave room for footer
AVAIL_H = CONTENT_BOT - CONTENT_TOP   # ~4567px to fill

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid background
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def t(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    """Center text horizontally & vertically at (x,y)."""
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    """Draw wrapped text; return next y."""
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        t((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent):
    """Section header with accent bar. Returns y after header."""
    rrect(x, y, x + 8, y + 58, accent, radius=4)
    t((x + 32, y - 4), title, fnt(S_B, 68), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        t((x + 32, y + 72), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 120
    return y + 80

def draw_card(x, y, w, h, accent=None):
    """Card with background, border, optional accent stripe."""
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=20)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=20, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent:
        rrect(x + 30, y + 24, x + 110, y + 30, accent, radius=3)

def warn_tri(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

def divider(y):
    hline(ML + INNER_W//4, ML + 3*INNER_W//4, y, GRID, width=1)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = CONTENT_TOP

# Title
rrect(ML, Y, ML + 8, Y + 170, ACCENT, radius=4)
t((ML + 36, Y), "JS Framework Benchmark", fnt(S_B, 132), WHITE)
t((ML + 36, Y + 140), "5 Years of Browser Performance Testing", fnt(S_B, 50), ACCENT2)
t((ML + 36, Y + 200), "Tracking JavaScript framework performance from Chrome 55 through Chrome 146  \u00b7  2017 \u2013 2026",
  fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)

Y += 300

# ── Hero stat cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HERO_W = (INNER_W - 100) // 3
HERO_H = 340
HERO_GAP = 50

heroes = [
    ("60+", "Official Benchmark Runs", "Published since 2017", ACCENT),
    ("55 \u2192 146", "Chrome Versions Covered", "Spanning ~8 years of browser releases", ACCENT2),
    ("Chrome 118", "Major Methodology Shift", "Scoring method fundamentally changed", WARN),
]

for i, (num, label, sub, color) in enumerate(heroes):
    hx = ML + i * (HERO_W + HERO_GAP)
    draw_card(hx, Y, HERO_W, HERO_H, color)

    nf = fnt(DMB, 100) if i < 2 else fnt(DMB, 48)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 55), num, nf, color)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 170), label, fnt(S_B, 36), WHITE)
    t((hx + 35, Y + 222), sub, fnt(S_R, 26), TEXT_DIM)

    # Bottom accent line
    rrect(hx + 35, Y + HERO_H - 28, hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + HERO_H - 22, color, radius=2)

    # Right-side stat highlight for first two cards
    if i == 0:
        t((hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + 58), "\u2605", fnt(DM, 28), ACCENT, anchor="ra")
    if i == 1:
        t((hx + HERO_W - 35, Y + 58), "\u2194", fnt(DM, 28), ACCENT2, anchor="ra")

Y += HERO_H + 70

divider(Y)
Y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. TIMELINE — CENTERPIECE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Y = sec_head(ML, Y, "Benchmark Timeline",
             "60+ official result sets across Chrome versions, 2017 \u2013 2026", ACCENT)

TL_TOP = Y
TL_H = 1400
TL_BOTTOM = TL_TOP + TL_H

rrect(ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM, BG_ALT, radius=22)
d.rounded_rectangle((ML, TL_TOP, RIGHT, TL_BOTTOM), radius=22, outline=GRID, width=2)

years = [
    ("2017\u2013\n2019",  "55, 58,\n62, 69",    4,  "Early era;\nstefankrause.net",   False),
    ("2020",               "83 \u2013 87",         5,  "Migrated to\nGitHub Pages",      False),
    ("2021",               "88 \u2013 96",         9,  "Steady monthly\ncadence",         False),
    ("2022",               "97 \u2013 108",       13,  "Peak year;\n2 Windows runs",      False),
    ("2023",               "109 \u2013 120",      12,  "Methodology\noverhaul at 118",    True),
    ("2024",               "121 \u2013 131",      12,  "Stable;\n1 Windows run",          False),
    ("2025",               "132 \u2013 143",      12,  "Keyed-only\nalternating",         False),
    ("2026",               "144 \u2013 146",       3,  "Latest: Chrome\n146 on macOS",    False),
]

n = len(years)
TRACK_Y = TL_TOP + 115

    for line in yr_lines:

        yy += 30

    # Chrome versions
    ch_lines = chrome.split("\n")
    cy = TRACK_Y + 38
    for line in ch_lines:
        ctx(cx, cy, line, fnt(DM, 22), ACCENT)
        cy += 26

    # Runs badge
    badge_sz = 64
    badge_y = cy + 8
    bcolor = ACCENT2 if runs == max_run else ACCENT
    if is_warn: bcolor = WARN
    rrect(cx - badge_sz//2, badge_y, cx + badge_sz//2, badge_y + 36, bcolor, radius=9)
    t((cx, badge_y + 18), str(runs), fnt(DMB, 26), WHITE, anchor="mm")
    t((cx, badge_y + 43), "runs", fnt(S_R, 17), TEXT_DIM, anchor="mt")

    # Note text
    note_y = badge_y + 68
    for line in note.split("\n"):
        nc = WARN if is_warn else TEXT_DIM
        ctx(cx, note_y, line, fnt(S_R, 20), nc)
        note_y += 22

    # Warning callout for Chrome 118

        ww, wh = 450, 140
        wx = cx - ww // 2
        wy = TRACK_Y - 240

        rrect(wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh, WARN_BG, radius=14)
        d.rounded_rectangle((wx, wy, wx + ww, wy + wh), radius=14, outline=WARN, width=3)

        warn_tri(wx + 44, wy + wh // 2, 22, WARN)

        t((wx + 85, wy + 18), "METHODOLOGY SHIFT", fnt(S_B, 34), WARN)
        t((wx + 85, wy + 60), "Arithmetic mean  \u2192  Weighted geometric mean", fnt(DM, 24), WARN)
        t((wx + 85, wy + 100), "Comparisons across Chrome 118 are not directly valid", fnt(S_R, 21), WARN_D)

        # Connector
        d.line([(cx, wy + wh), (cx, TRACK_Y - 26)], fill=WARN, width=3)

        # Side annotation
        if i + 1 < n:

            for j, line in enumerate(["Cross-version", "comparisons", "before/after", "Chrome 118",
                                       "are NOT reliable."]):
                t((nx, wy + 2 + j * 24), line, fnt(S_R, 21), RED)

    r = 26 if is_warn else 16
    fill = WARN if is_warn else ACCENT
    d.ellipse((cx - r, TRACK_Y - r, cx + r, TRACK_Y + r), fill=fill, outline=BG_ALT, width=5)
