#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""JS Framework Benchmark poster — A1 portrait, dark dev-tool aesthetic.
Fills ~90% of the canvas with content, leaving breathing room at top and bottom."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG        = (10, 14, 26)
BG_ALT   = (17, 22, 40)
GRID      = (30, 38, 62)
ACCENT    = (0, 212, 255)
ACCENT2   = (20, 184, 166)
WARN      = (251, 191, 36)
WARN_D    = (180, 130, 10)
WARN_BG   = (46, 36, 10)
RED       = (239, 68, 68)
PURPLE    = (139, 92, 246)
TEXT      = (220, 225, 235)
TEXT_DIM  = (135, 145, 165)
TEXT_FAINT= (75, 85, 105)
WHITE     = (245, 248, 255)
DOT       = (17, 22, 40)

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 160, 160
MT, MB = 150, 110
RIGHT = W - MR
INNER_W = RIGHT - ML

# Available vertical space to fill
CONTENT_TOP = MT + 30
CONTENT_BOT = H - MB - 120   # leave room for footer
AVAIL_H = CONTENT_BOT - CONTENT_TOP   # ~4567px to fill

# ── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
S_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
S_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
M_R  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Regular.ttf"
M_B  = f"{FD}/liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf"
DM   = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
DMB  = f"{FD}/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"

def fnt(path, sz):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, sz)

# ── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Dot grid background
for gx in range(0, W, 28):
    for gy in range(0, H, 28):
        d.point((gx, gy), fill=DOT)

# ── Drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def t(xy, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT, anchor=None):
    d.text(xy, txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_, anchor=anchor)

def bbox(txt_, font_):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), txt_, font=font_)

def tw(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(txt_, font_):
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def ctx(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_=TEXT):
    """Center text horizontally & vertically at (x,y)."""
    bb = bbox(txt_, font_)
    d.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y - (bb[3]-bb[1])//2), txt_, font=font_, fill=fill_)

def rrect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill_, radius=0, outline=None, width=1):
    if radius:
        d.rounded_rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), radius=radius, fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        d.rectangle((x1, y1, x2, y2), fill=fill_, outline=outline, width=width)

def hline(x1, x2, y, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def vline(x, y1, y2, fill_, width=1):
    d.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=fill_, width=width)

def wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
    words = txt_.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
        if tw(test, font_) > max_w:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def dwrap(x, y, txt_, font_, fill_, max_w, lh):
    """Draw wrapped text; return next y."""
    for line in wrap(txt_, font_, max_w):
        t((x, y), line, font_, fill_)
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(x, y, title, subtitle, accent):
    """Section header with accent bar. Returns y after header."""
    rrect(x, y, x + 8, y + 58, accent, radius=4)
    t((x + 32, y - 4), title, fnt(S_B, 68), WHITE)
    if subtitle:
        t((x + 32, y + 72), subtitle, fnt(S_R, 30), TEXT_DIM)
        return y + 120
    return y + 80

def draw_card(x, y, w, h, accent=None):
    """Card with background, border, optional accent stripe."""
    rrect(x, y, x + w, y + h, BG_ALT, radius=20)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + h), radius=20, outline=GRID, width=2)
    if accent:
        rrect(x + 30, y + 24, x + 110, y + 30, accent, radius=3)

def warn_tri(cx, cy, sz, fill_):
    d.polygon([(cx, cy - sz), (cx + sz, cy + int(sz*0.7)),
               (cx - sz, cy + int(sz*0.7))], fill=fill_)

def divider(y):
    hline(ML + INNER_W//4, ML + 3*INNER_W//4, y, GRID, width=1)

# ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rrect(0, 0, W, 6, ACCENT)
